snippet.title: SOUL PARK - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
On September 22, join Satanas and build an infernal theme park in SOUL PARK !

After 1 year in early access on Steam, the official release will include a major update and a mobile release!

Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2992460/SOUL_PARK/
